summary.t: Birth plaque with the details of the day your baby was born.

text.t:
A delicate and charming piece, created to eternalise the first details of your baby's life.
Made from pine plywood in a circular shape, it brings together the birth details in a unique and meaningful composition, featuring laser engraving of the name and a delicate lace for hanging.
A little handmade treasure, where every detail tells a love story.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: Always hang it out of reach of the baby — above or outside the cot, never inside it: the cord could become tangled. Check from time to time that it remains securely fastened.
